subject: maths
question:
The pie chart given below shows the monthly expenditure of a family (in rupees) on various items.If the total earning is ₹70,560, then find the difference between the amount spent on Education and Rent.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/08cb6b7d3efe9d3d5b062f6b76ca8af81e2187a980c5bba36299d74ff88aa374.png]
solution:
**Given:**

Total earning = ₹70,560

Expenditure on Education and Rent (in degrees) from the pie chart:

Education = 30%

Rent = 20%

**Formula used:**

Expenditure on an item = (Total earning × amount spent on that item)</
